point: A noun follows the blank: whose, not who's.
空格後接名詞：用 whose，不是 who's。
why: résumé follows the blank directly and means "his résumé", so the possessive whose is needed. Who's means who is or who has and cannot be followed by a noun.
résumé 直接接在空格後，意思是「他的履歷」，要用所有格 whose。who's 是 who is 或 who has，後面不能接名詞。

gloss.ex: Each finalist gave a ten-minute talk.
She manages customs compliance for the firm.
Three names are on the shortlist.

point: After a comma, which can be the subject; where needs a full clause.
逗號後 which 可以當主詞；where 後要接完整子句。
why: Take out despite its age and its cramped doors: the verb handles has no subject. The blank must supply it, and after a comma that is which. Where would need a subject of its own.
拿掉 despite its age and its cramped doors：handles 沒有主詞。空格要補上主詞，逗號後是 which。where 需要自己的主詞。

gloss.ex: The aircraft stayed in the hangar overnight.
The cramped office had no storage space.
The regional fleet has twelve aircraft.

point: which can refer to a whole clause.
which 可以指前面整個子句。
why: The blank refers to the whole announcement that crossings would be suspended, not to one noun. After a comma that is which. It would join two sentences with only a comma, and that cannot follow a comma.
空格指的是整個「暫停通行」的消息，不是單一名詞。逗號後用 which。it 會讓兩句只靠逗號相連，that 不能接在逗號後。

gloss.ex: Service was suspended during the storm.
The ramp was closed for repairs.
Costs rose, which in turn raised prices.

point: what = the thing that; no noun before it.
what = the thing that；前面沒有名詞。
why: No noun comes before the blank, and had recommended has no object. The blank is that missing object and means the thing that: what. That needs a complete clause after it.
空格前面沒有名詞，而 had recommended 缺受詞。空格就是這個受詞，意思是 the thing that：what。that 後面要接完整子句。

gloss.ex: The credit committee meets every Tuesday.
External auditors review the accounts yearly.
The risk department reports to the board.

point: A preposition's object is missing: preposition + whom.
缺介系詞的受詞：介系詞 + whom。
why: collaborated on every title needs with + a person, and the clause has no with. The blank must supply both the preposition and the person: with whom. Bare whom leaves collaborated without its preposition.
collaborated on every title 需要 with + 人，子句裡沒有 with。空格要同時補上介系詞和人：with whom。單用 whom，collaborated 就缺了介系詞。

gloss.ex: The translator finished the novel in June.
The two firms collaborated on the design.
She will train her successor.

point: situations where + a complete clause.
situations where + 完整子句。
why: The clause a supplier cannot … deliver within the agreed period is complete; nothing is missing, so which and whom have no gap to fill. Where follows situations and takes a full clause.
子句 a supplier cannot … deliver within the agreed period 是完整的，沒有缺口，所以 which 和 whom 沒有位置。where 接在 situations 後，後面是完整子句。

gloss.ex: The delay was beyond our control.
We may extend the deadline by a week.
Guests may cancel without penalty.

point: A complete clause needs preposition + which.
完整子句要用 介系詞 + which。
why: the inspectors interviewed … more than sixty drivers has a subject and an object, so nothing is missing for which to fill. The clause needs a preposition that gives the time: during which.
the inspectors interviewed … more than sixty drivers 有主詞也有受詞，which 沒有缺口可填。子句需要表示時間的介系詞：during which。

gloss.ex: The compliance audit covered all branches.
Maintenance logs are stored for five years.
The firm runs four depots in the region.

point: A possessive before a noun: whose.
名詞前的所有格：whose。
why: combined enrollment follows the blank with no article. It belongs to the campuses, so the possessive whose is needed; it works for things too. Of which would need the … of which.
combined enrollment 接在空格後，沒有冠詞。它屬於這些校區，所以用所有格 whose，事物也可以用。of which 要寫成 the … of which。

gloss.ex: The college opened a satellite campus downtown.
Enrollment rose by ten percent.
Demand exceeds supply this season.

point: Quantity + of whom after a comma.
逗號後：數量 + of whom。
why: A full sentence ends at the comma, and the blank starts a new clause about the nurses with the verb had. Many of whom both joins the clause and points back to them. Many of them would leave only a comma between two sentences.
逗號前是完整句子，空格要開一個指 nurses 的新子句，動詞是 had。many of whom 同時連接並指回護理師。many of them 會讓兩句只靠逗號相連。

gloss.ex: The staffing agency found us two temps.
He works in intensive care.
Orientation takes place on the first day.

point: none of which for three or more; neither is for two.
三個以上用 none of which；neither 只用於兩個。
why: The board received three proposals, so neither is out: it means one of two. After the comma, a relative form is also needed to join the clause. That gives none of which.
董事會收到 three proposals，所以不能用 neither（只指兩者）。逗號後也需要關係詞來連接子句，所以是 none of which。

gloss.ex: We received six proposals for the contract.
The budget ceiling was set in March.
The finance committee reviews all large costs.

point: whichever chooses one from a set.
whichever 從一組選項中擇一。
why: The sentence gives two dates and asks for the later one. Whichever is later means the one that is later, chosen from those two dates. Whoever is for people, and whenever and wherever do not fit.
句子給了兩個日期，要選較晚的那個。whichever is later 的意思是從這兩個日期中選 the one that is later。whoever 指人，whenever 和 wherever 不合。

gloss.ex: The extended warranty covers three more years.
The sensor detected a small leak.
Please keep your proof of purchase.

point: whatever = anything that; no noun before it.
whatever = anything that；前面沒有名詞。
why: offer guests already has its object, so the blank opens a new noun clause meaning anything that. they judge is inserted, and will resolve needs a subject: whatever. That would point back to guests.
offer guests 已經有受詞，所以空格開啟一個意思是 anything that 的名詞子句。they judge 是插入語，will resolve 缺主詞：whatever。that 會指回 guests。

gloss.ex: Guests receive a complimentary breakfast.
Call the duty manager after hours.
We handled the complaint within a day.

point: A noun + past participle can replace that were + participle.
名詞後的過去分詞可取代 that were + 分詞。
why: The main verb is will be returned at the end, so the blank cannot hold another finite verb. The documents are filed by someone, so the blank is a past participle: filed, meaning that are filed.
主要動詞是句尾的 will be returned，所以空格不能再放有時態的動詞。文件是被人提交的，所以用過去分詞 filed，意思是 that are filed。

gloss.ex: File the form at the court registry.
The filing deadline is Friday.
The claimant sent two letters.

point: A noun + -ing can replace who + verb.
名詞後的 -ing 可取代 who + 動詞。
why: The main verb is have been reporting, so the blank cannot hold another finite verb. The technicians do the calibrating, and the quarterly calibration is the object: performing, meaning who perform.
主要動詞是 have been reporting，所以空格不能再放有時態的動詞。技術員是執行校正的人，the quarterly calibration 是受詞：performing，意思是 who perform。

gloss.ex: Calibration takes about two hours.
Two extruders were shut down.
He has worked here for a decade.

point: A person as subject after a comma: who.
逗號後的人當主詞：who。
why: Take out after eleven years with the city's tourism board: now oversees has no subject. The blank supplies it, and for a person after a comma that is who. That cannot follow a comma.
拿掉 after eleven years with the city's tourism board：now oversees 沒有主詞。空格要補上，逗號後的人是 who。that 不能接在逗號後。

gloss.ex: The tourism board runs a visitor center.
She oversees all hiring.
Volunteers handed out the programs.

point: An object is missing: which; where needs a full clause.
缺受詞：which；where 後要接完整子句。
why: commissioned needs an object, but the retailer … commissioned in the northern region has none. The blank is that object and refers to the center: which. Where would leave commissioned without an object.
commissioned 需要受詞，但 the retailer … commissioned in the northern region 沒有。空格就是這個受詞，指 center：which。where 會讓 commissioned 沒有受詞。

gloss.ex: The distribution center ships to forty stores.
The city commissioned a new library.
Staff process claims within a week.

point: A passive clause with no agent: by whom.
被動子句缺動作者：by whom。
why: had been drafted is passive, and the clause has no by phrase. The consultants are the ones who drafted it, so the blank supplies the agent: by whom. Whom alone leaves the passive without its preposition.
had been drafted 是被動，子句裡沒有 by 片語。顧問是起草的人，所以空格補上動作者：by whom。單用 whom，被動句就缺了介系詞。

gloss.ex: The trial protocol lists every step.
Patients sign consent forms first.
Legal drafted the contract in May.

point: What starts a noun clause with a missing object.
What 開頭的名詞子句，缺受詞。
why: needs most from the new reporting tool has no object, and no noun comes before the blank. The blank is that object and also starts the subject of is: What. That needs a complete clause after it.
needs most from the new reporting tool 沒有受詞，空格前面也沒有名詞。空格就是這個受詞，同時開頭當 is 的主詞：What。That 後面要接完整子句。

gloss.ex: The reporting tool exports to a spreadsheet.
Regional managers visit each branch monthly.
The figures were updated on Monday.
